data.change_summary: Reworked shrimp lifecycle progression to use deterministic signed carry math for adult->berried and clutch-resolution transfers, rewired molt timing so failed molts can occur under poor mineral/condition states, and added defaulted carry fields so current/legacy saves keep loading through the existing migration path. Also exposed `total_shrimp_count` plus `sub_adult_count` on snapshot/biology surfaces, updated the overview/biology TUI and harness shrimp totals, and added regression coverage for deterministic spawn/hatch behavior, failed molts, snapshot/API totals, and harness counting.
outstanding_risks: Long-horizon population balance changed from per-individual RNG to deterministic rounding with signed carry; I validated focused shrimp/save suites but did not rerun the full scenario/e2e matrix.
The TUI surface was compile-validated, but there are still no render/snapshot tests covering the updated shrimp overview text.

steps.description: Inspect the current shrimp stage model, remediation gaps, and outward-facing snapshot/API/TUI/harness surfaces to pin down the required fixes.
Implement deterministic berried and hatch transfers plus a reachable molt-failure path, with new defaulted carry fields to preserve save compatibility.
Expose total/sub-adult shrimp counts across snapshot, biology API, overview/biology TUI, and harness shrimp totals, and add targeted regression tests for those surfaces.
Run focused compilation and test validation for the touched scientific-core, save, API, harness, and TUI crates.
